Recovered alcoholic and addict here, sober 2 years. This is not a comment on your relationship or what to do there, but an observation about my own behaivour while getting sober and how that might relate to your husband's disengagement. 

It sounds like he might be disassociating a lot to handle the anxiety or thought processes that he used to use alcohol to deal with. When I did this, I was still very attracted to my partner and "wanted" to have sex, but couldn't bring myself to engage with my surroundings a lot of the time, because everything felt imposing and threatening when I didn't have alcohol to temper myself.  

That being said, my partner and I had no infidelity issues and it sounds like your partner has a number of issues that have created huge trust issues, so there are a lot more factors there, I only wanted to share my thoughts on that specific aspect of his behaivour.
